headline: Trump Announces Audi Plans $4 Billion Assembly Plant in Georgia
summary: Audi plans to construct a $4 billion assembly factory in Perry, Georgia, designed to manufacture 200,000 sport utility vehicles annually.
why: Audi is a luxury automotive brand within the Volkswagen Group, one of the world's largest vehicle manufacturers. Large-scale auto assembly investments drive regional manufacturing employment and supply-chain capital expenditure.

impacts.name: Volkswagen AG
impacts.why: A $4 billion capital expenditure commitment increases US manufacturing capacity but requires significant upfront financing.

impacts.name: Automotive Manufacturing
impacts.why: A new plant producing 200,000 SUVs annually increases domestic vehicle output and local supply contracts.
